auth.openInPiBrowser: Fur boggan Pi Browser si aad ugu gasho akoonkaaga Pi.
auth.linkRequired: Waxaad ku gashay Google, laakiin weli kuma xirna akoon Pi. Soo saar kood xiriiriye Pi Browser oo halkan geli.
auth.linkNeeded: Xiriirinta akoonka Pi ayaa loo baahan yahay
auth.linkCheckFailed: Lama hubin karin heerka xiriirinta akoonkaaga (qalad server ku meel gaar ah). Fadlan dib u cusboonaysii daqiiqad gudaheed.

link.title: Xiriiri akoon
link.intro: Ku xir akoonka aad ku gashay Pi Browser galitaanka Google ee browser caadi ah. Ka dib xiriirinta waxaad isticmaali kartaa akoon isku mid ah browser PC.
link.piIssueTitle: Si aad uga gasho browser caadi ah sidoo kale
link.codeHint: Soo saar koodka hoose, ka dibna ku gal Google browser PC oo geli bogga Xiriiri akoon (10 daqiiqo gudahood).
link.enterHint: Pi Browser ka fur dbms.pi → Xiriiri akoon → Soo saar kood xiriiriye, ka dibna geli koodka 6-da lambar ah.
link.done: Waa la xiray. Hadda waxaad isticmaali kartaa galitaanka Google sidoo kale.
link.linked: {name} wuxuu ku xiran yahay galitaanka Google.

piOAuth.failed: Galitaanka Pi wuu fashilmay. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
piOAuth.stateMismatch: Lama xaqiijin karin codsigan galitaanka (dhacay ama tab kale). Fadlan isku day mar kale.

apiErrors.AUTH_PI_REQUIRED: Galitaanka Pi ayaa loo baahan yahay
apiErrors.AUTH_PI_SESSION_INVALID: Fadhigaagu wuu dhacay. Fadlan mar kale gal
apiErrors.SERVER_CONFIG: Qaladka qaabeynta server-ka. Fadlan la xiriir hawlwadeenka
apiErrors.DB_UNAVAILABLE: Xogta si ku meel gaar ah uma heli karto. Fadlan isku day mar dambe
apiErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Codsiyo badan. Fadlan isku day mar dhow
apiErrors.AUTH_PI_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT: Magacan isticmaale ee Pi wuxuu horey u diiwaan gashan yahay aqoonsiyo kala duwan. Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha
apiErrors.AUTH_PI_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Akoonkan waa mid aan shaqaynayn. Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha
apiErrors.AUTH_GOOGLE_REQUIRED: Galitaanka Google ayaa loo baahan yahay.
apiErrors.LINK_CODE_INVALID: Koodka xiriirinta waa mid aan sax ahayn ama wuu dhacay. Soo saar mid cusub Pi Browser.
apiErrors.LINK_ALREADY_LINKED: Akoonkan wuu horey u xiran yahay.
apiErrors.LINK_CODE_GEN_FAILED: Lama abuuri karin kood xiriiriye. Fadlan isku day mar dambe.
apiErrors.AUTH_DB_UNAVAILABLE: Lama kaydin karin akoonkaaga, sidaa darteed galitaanka wuu fashilmay. Fadlan isku day mar dambe.
apiErrors.LINK_TRY_LIMIT: Koodadka xiriirinta ee khaldan ayaa aad u badan. Isku day mar kale 15 daqiiqo gudahood.
